Reviewer action: Compare the NavigationGate capability, MK2 family update, 2026-09-01 current activity and DDI program participation before accepting any operation.

OSCP's official portfolio distinguishes MK2M2, MK2E2, MK2Z and NavigationGate by architecture, maturity and processing role.

CA3119383 identifies OSCPS as assignee on an optical-gyroscope family and records a Canadian grant publication dated January 27, 2026; OSCP separately states a broader 40-issued-patent count.
OSCP presents MK2M2 as a shipping tactical MEMS IMU with RS-422 and CAN-FD interfaces, an IP67 enclosure and a -40 to 85 degree Celsius operating range.
OSCP presents MK2E2 as a hybrid photonic-and-MEMS IMU with an optical gyroscope on the z-axis and preliminary public specifications.
OSCP presents MK2Z as an early-access or prototype navigation-grade photonic IMU whose public specifications and ingress-protection status remain preliminary or in progress.
OSCP documents RS-422 and CAN-FD data frames with raw output up to 500 Hz and AHRS output up to 100 Hz for MK2 integration.

True North Map separates the MK2 family's MEMS, hybrid-photonic and navigation-grade configurations and preserves their different shipping, preliminary and prototype maturity states; no Mission match is added at the component-family level.

candidateChanges.reviewer_rationale: Coverage value: OSCPS Motion Sensing can replace the generic capability with a bounded MK2 family and add the distinct NavigationGate inertial navigation system, current activity, contact, financing and three federal program paths. Evidence: 21 durable sources from OSCP, CanadaBuys, NRC, ISED, NGen and a representative Canadian patent record establish the product architecture, dated launch, public contracts, contributions and limits. Mission/Public Need read: A new proposed Autonomous Patrol and Monitoring connection is attached only to the NavigationGate capability because fused navigation could support an uncrewed patrol platform; no Public Need match is created and the record does not establish platform integration or accepted field performance. Unknowns: No public NavigationGate manual, independent test, completed qualification, shipment, customer acceptance, production capacity or operational deployment was found. Reviewer action: Compare the NavigationGate capability, MK2 family update, 2026-09-01 current activity and DDI program participation before accepting any operation.
